versions.changelog:
- Initial release of workbuddy-expert-sync (本地专家跨账号同步 / Cross-Account Expert Sync).
- Enables all locally created experts and expert teams to be visible and synced across every WorkBuddy account on the same machine, including future accounts.
- Diagnoses and resolves the issue where local experts disappear after switching accounts by syncing expert registry files based on shared expert package directories.
- Provides automatic scheduled syncing, complete with backup, verification steps, and safe recovery instructions.
- Includes clear user notifications for each action, with guidance on validation and removal.
- Only affects the current device; does not migrate expert package folders, only syncs expert registries across accounts.
